# Twitter Reader

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. What fintwit is shouting about is a sentiment sample with loud biases, not research consensus: a viral thread can be wrong, paid, or posted after the move, and trading on it carries a real risk of loss. No output here is a promise of return. Curated by Skill Harbor: a read-only reader for Twitter and X, built for financial research, that runs through opencli and reuses the Chrome session you are already logged into, so there is no X API key and no cookie extraction. It reads your home timeline (for-you or following), tweet search with top or live filters, trending topics, your bookmarks, any account's recent tweets, full threads, long-form articles, profiles with follower counts, followers and following lists, and your notifications, returning structured fields for each tweet (author, text, timestamps, likes, retweets, replies, views and media links). Presentation is part of the skill: lead with what matters for the research question, attribute each tweet with its handle and engagement, group search results by theme, and note the bullish or bearish lean and whether a view looks like consensus or contrarian. From the himself65/finance-skills repository (MIT). Honest caveats: this reader is honest about reading a third-party platform through your own account and tools: you need Chrome with the opencli Browser Bridge extension installed, Node.js 20 or later, and your own x.com login...
